correctness.rationale: For any potential motif copy, exactly its incident edges are forced at its own vertices; the conditional degree is d+Bin(n-1-d,p). Off-copy degrees are unchanged, and the binomial ratio gives the exact normalized covariance. Each positive summand strictly decreases in p, and increases in k via falling factorials; this proves unique ordered zeros and both boundary signs. Uniform-in-compact-c second-order expansion and negative derivative prove sparse root correction. A separately executable exhaustive finite checker passed 3299 checks through six vertices.

value.rationale: Canonical global degree-frequency and motif-count statistics have a full sign diagram not accessible from their separate marginal laws. Normalization unexpectedly deletes every motif adjacency detail except its degree multiset; every eligible degree class has one unique crossing, and those crossings are strictly ordered. The motif-dependent second-order sparse correction gives a meaningful precise dependence window and produces explicit regular-motif thresholds.
